context.shared_brief: Read the source in full as requirements truth and the human tasks Shared implementation context; do not use SDD as requirements input. Carry the assigned outcome, predecessor interfaces, exclusions, task-local REQUIRED acceptance entries and genuine action gates into each worker brief. The current launch supplies current authority under ADR-0003; historical preparation labels do not veto authorized scope or authorize external actions. Ordinary bounded isolated fixtures/local databases need no extra approval under ADR-0004; credentials, unrelated data, global installs, paid scope and external writes remain protected. Use the selected executor configuration unchanged; no per-task binding metadata. Each acceptance entry below is REQUIRED, with check, pass condition, evidence and permission. Run checks after affected changes, inspect actual owned diffs and preserve focused runner-owned checkpoints, hooks/signing, unrelated work and independent final review. Do not create routine evidence/state/memory files.
context.scope: Only replace active docs/open_issues.md unresolved-work tracking and its direct consumers/docs, and deliver reusable faithful import-open-issues.
